title: Scattering MIMO Channel
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Scattering_MIMO_Channel.md
text: Scattering MIMO propagation channel, 12 inputs, 5 outputs, {Geometry} sets Array geometry; {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 3e8, {Polarization configuration}, {Specify atmospheric parameters} enables atmospheric attenuation model, {Temperature (degrees Celsius)} sets the ambient temperature, {Dry air pressure (Pa)} sets the atmospheric dry air, {Water vapour density (g/m^3)} sets the atmospheric water vapor density, {Liquid water density (g/m^3)}, {Rain rate (mm/hr)} sets the rainfall rate, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Simulate direct path propagation} enables propagation along direct path, {Maximum delay (s)} sets the maximum signal delay 10e-6, {Output channel response} enables output of channel response, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System, {Element type} sets the array element types, {Operating frequency range (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of the antenna or microphone element, {Operating frequency vector (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of custom antenna or microphone elements, {Baffle the back of the element} sets the back response of an Isotropic Antenna element or an Omni Microphone element, {Exponent of cosine pattern} sets the exponents of azimuth and elevation cosine patterns, {Frequency responses (dB)} sets the antenna and microphone frequency response, {Input Pattern Coordinate System} sets the coordinate system of custom antenna pattern, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Phi Angles (deg)} sets the phi angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Theta Angles (deg)} sets the theta angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Magnitude pattern (dB)} sets the magnitude of combined antenna radiation pattern, {Phase pattern (deg)} sets the custom antenna radiation phase pattern, {MatchArrayNormal} sets the rotate antenna element to array normal, {Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} sets the polar pattern microphone response frequencies, {Polar pattern angles (deg)} sets the polar pattern response angles, {Polar pattern (dB)} sets the custom microphone polar response zeros, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA, {Element spacing (m)} sets the spacing between array elements 0.5 for ULA arrays, {Array axis} sets the linear axis direction, {Array size} sets the dimensions of URA array, {Element lattice} sets the lattice of URA element positions, {Array normal}, {Radius of UCA (m)} sets the uCA array radius, {Element positions (m)} sets the positions of conformal array elements, {Element normals (deg)} sets the direction of conformal array element normal vectors, {Taper} sets the array element tapers, {Source of transmit array motion} sets the source of the transmitting array motion parameters, {Position of the transmit array (m)} sets the position of transmitting array, {Orientation of the transmit array} sets the orientation of transmitting array axes, {Source of receive array motion} sets the source of the receiving array motion parameters, {Position of the receive array (m)} sets the position of receiving array, {Orientation of the receive array} sets the orientation of receiving array axes, {Scatterer specification} sets the source of scatterer parameters, {Number of scatterers}, {Boundary of scatterer positions} sets the constrain scatterer positions within a boundary, {Positions of scatterers (m)} sets the positions of scatterers and {ScattererCoefficient} sets the scattering coefficients. Values come from the instance.
